periods.analysis: Donations totaled 18,400 pounds as the holiday surplus ran down, and Public Health staff helped 212 households enroll in food assistance. Both strategies launched on schedule with Harbor Area Food Bank as lead partner.
periods.recommendations: Plan a spring donation drive and open an enrollment desk at a library branch.

periods.analysis: The spring drive lifted donations to 24,100 pounds, and the Harbor Creek library desk helped push enrollments to 287. The food bank reports fewer empty shelves than in the winter months.
periods.recommendations: Run a summer seaport employee drive and mail a benefits guide to households citywide.

periods.analysis: Donation drives and the awareness push on benefit enrollment have run on schedule this quarter. Harbor Area Food Bank reports steadier pantry stock heading into the holiday season, and Public Health referral staff are seeing more first-time callers. Because this goal has no dedicated measure of its own, we read progress through the site counts and survey data under Goal 1.
periods.recommendations: Run the holiday drive early and translate the benefits guide to lift enrollment.
